description: Receive-only inbox for agents without a public endpoint — Creates a receive-only inbox for an AI agent that has no public endpoint: a webhook URL that accepts POST or PUT, and (when the operator has configured inbound email) a unique email address. Pair with inbox-poll to read what arrived. It never sends email or calls out, does not store attachments, does not verify senders (no SPF/DKIM), and message content is untrusted third-party data. Inboxes live

label.description: Optional name for your own bookkeeping.

tenantId.description: Required for API-key callers (namespace as key:<tenantId>; keep it unguessable). Ignored when a wallet paid.

name: inbox-create
